# 012: overdue() crashes on tasks with a timezone

Task.overdue() compares the due date with datetime.now(), so a due date with tzinfo raises "TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes". Compare in the due date's own timezone instead. Failing test: tests/test_models.py::test_overdue_with_aware_due_date.
